image_description: A close-up view of a textured, parchment-style paper menu. The top features a decorative illustration of a red pitcher and glass with floral elements. Below the illustration is a header that appears to read 'Appetizers' in a stylized font, followed by several lines of item descriptions and prices. The text is rendered in a dark, serif typeface against a beige background.
